title: One state, many questions: Opsis gives a frontier model typed eyes for pathology
abstract: arXiv:2611.27102v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A synoptic pathology report is a checklist of questions with fixed answer sets, many composed from others. Pathology foundation models answer them accurately with one classifier trained with labels for each, and frontier language models, which compose freely, cannot fit a slide of fourteen thousand tiles in their context. On 189 breast report questions, frontier models that read a written description of the slide or look at a thumbnail and tiles of it answer at 0.50 to 0.66, below the majority class at 0.67. A description is written before the question is known, and a look covers a handful of tiles. We present Opsis, which lets the model ask instead: a typed question interface on a frozen pathology encoder. A slide is encoded once, a question names an operator, arguments and candidates given at runtime, and the answer is a probability over the candidates. translated_title: 一种状态，众多问题：Opsis为前沿模型赋予病理分析的类型化视觉能力
translated_abstract: 综合性病理报告是一份包含固定答案集的问题清单，其中许多答案由其他答案组合而成。病理学基础模型可以通过为每个问题单独训练的带标签分类器来准确回答这些问题，而可以自由组合的前沿语言模型却无法将包含一万四千个图块的切片纳入其上下文中。在189个乳腺报告问题上，通过阅读切片文字描述或查看缩略图及部分图块来回答问题的前沿模型，准确率仅为0.50至0.66，低于多数类基线的0.67。文字描述是在问题未知之前写就的，而一次观看只能覆盖少量图块。我们提出Opsis，让模型能够主动提问：这是构建在冻结病理编码器之上的类型化问题接口。切片只需编码一次，问题在运行时指定一个算子、参数和候选答案，答案则是候选答案上的概率分布。我们将其实现为构建在冻结Virchow2令牌之上的1000万参数解码器（Opsis-S）……
tldr: Opsis提出了一种构建在冻结病理编码器上的类型化问题接口，让前沿语言模型能够对仅编码一次的病理切片主动提问，在运行时指定算子、参数和候选答案并获得概率化结果，从而解决了语言模型无法处理大规模病理切片且固定描述性能低下的问题。
en_tdlr: Opsis introduces a typed question interface on a frozen pathology encoder, enabling frontier language models to actively query a slide encoded once—specifying operators, arguments, and candidates at runtime to obtain probabilistic answers—overcoming the limitations of language models that cannot process massive pathology slides and underperform with fixed descriptions.
